lines.en: So that's your second marriage in two years.
Ross, I have been a divorce attorney for 23 years
and never have I had so much business from one client.
Why don't you tell me what happened?
Basically, Rachel and I were in Vegas and we got drunk.
Is this the same Rachel whose name you said at the altar
But I do not love her.
This was just a drunken mistake
and I need to get it annulled.
I think just the annulment for today.
There are a couple of forms to fill out.
And we'll need to have witnesses who can testify
that you were not of a sound mind.
And we'll need you and Rachel to testify before a judge.
There's no way to do this without her
because I kind of already told her
unless you and Rachel are both there.
What about someone who looks like Rachel?
I will think about the therapy.
